validation.notes: Full official eLife Reviewed Preprint v1 API indexContent checked 2026-09-28. Introduction and Motivation names public neuPrint dataset MANC and links exported datasets via Janelia; Methods > 2.1 identifies a five-day-old male VNC specimen. The v1 indexContent has no Abstract, Results, Discussion or Data availability heading and does not pin an immutable export/release for S740 processed matrices. DOI 10.7554/eLife.97769.1 identifies this reviewed-preprint version.

ограничения.value: The eLife article is a Reviewed Preprint v1, not an independent experimental validation of S740's model. It identifies the public neuPrint MANC dataset but not the exact export/release underlying S740's processed matrix. Motor-control anatomy cannot be interpreted as subjective pain or human ECAP/SCS evidence.
